title: Semisimplification of a Weil representation
statement:
For a composition series
$V_\bullet$, the *semisimplification* is

$$
V^{\mathrm{ss}}:=\bigoplus_{i=1}^{t}V_i/V_{i-1}.
$$

That its isomorphism class does not depend on the chosen composition
series is recorded with the other properties of this construction; the
multiset of its simple summands is the composition-factor multiset of
[lem-mg-jordan-holder].

noncomputable def semisimplification :
    Representation k W (⨁ (i : Fin s.length), ((s.series i.succ).toSubmodule ⧸
      (s.series i.castSucc).toSubmodule.comap (s.series i.succ).toSubmodule.subtype)) :=
lean.note: The current published source (read with scompile.py --source) defines precisely the direct sum of the successive quotient representations of the recorded Representation.CompositionSeries. The factor index Fin s.length is zero-based, so factor i is V_(i+1)/V_i. The same module supplies isIrreducible_directSumSummand and isInternal_semisimplification, and nonempty_semisimplification_equiv proves independence up to representation equivalence using the recorded jordanHolder. Thus the current blueprint_update clauses are covered too. The construction is generic in a group representation admitting a composition series and specializes without change to the finite-dimensional Weil representation of the dependency node; no alternate definition or extra hypothesis is introduced.
